objective: Recheck the J21 scalar fix and process supervisor behavior on the available Windows platform, using exact pytest function nodeids only.

expected.scalar_conversion: Both overflow and TypeError conversion edge cases return INCONCLUSIVE without crashing the caller.
expected.normal_worker: Exact synthetic residual PASS and FAIL are preserved independently.
expected.worker_error: Worker exception remains INCONCLUSIVE and does not promote a later case incorrectly.
expected.timeout_and_stop: Timeout and stop request terminate the worker and observed descendants; completed records remain intact and unresolved cases remain INCONCLUSIVE.
expected.rss: A sampled soft threshold is documented and causes termination; it is not interpreted as an OS quota.
expected.incomplete: Missing or malformed worker result cannot become PASS.
expected.monitor_fault: Unexpected monitor failure cleans up its process tree and is atomically journaled INCONCLUSIVE.

interpretation: A passing software test validates the tested supervisor behavior on this Windows runtime only. POSIX process groups and hard memory quotas are outside this contract.
historical_policy: No J14-J21 scientific result or guard verdict is changed.
